method: agent-browser session ux-walker-devin-r3 at 1440x900 light (dark checks on first visit and key rejected), switcher widths 1100, 900, 390, real browser widths 1100x800, 900x800, 390x844. Geometry audit run at each width: pageOverflowX 0, overflowSpills empty; 'wrappedControls' lists only td.dim.tab cells whose height is stretched by wrapped neighbours (false positives, text does not wrap); unevenRows list only mockup chrome and the dialog footers.

previous_findings.evidence: Dialog now has the 40px letter tile, title and a tinted footer (same anatomy as the generic connection dialog).
The Integrations catalog tile is an existing app surface, not part of the Devin page mockup; not observable here.
Empty (Connect disabled), connecting and refused dialog states are drawn. The connecting frame lacks a visible cue; logged as F-STORY-001-06.
The number is stated once (tile). Group heading has no number, the dot has no number, the agent reply no longer repeats a count. Dot and per-row badges remain as presence signals.
Shared colour tokens (V10) are intentionally unchanged; not re-raised. Measured again: warning text rgb(183,121,31), success rgb(34,139,59) on the same surfaces.
Dot is aria-hidden with screen-reader text 'new' (the real shell's pattern), per V1.
'Needs you 0' with other sessions present is still not drawn; Empty frame draws no tiles.
Refetch after answering in Devin is planned behaviour; not observable in a static mockup. No refresh cue is drawn, which is consistent with the decision (no refresh button).
Wait time is still only the Updated column.
User bubbles use the chat-user token; the real UserTextBubble also uses bg-chat-user. Colour belongs to shared tokens (V10).
Collapse icon measures 28x28 (above the 24px WCAG 2.2 minimum; it copies the real panel header).
'Panel: first Ask' frame shows the intro line and two suggestion buttons.
'I can't read that question. Open Add CSV export in Devin' is drawn. New inconsistency: F-STORY-012-09.
Toast body when the question is unavailable is not drawn; only the full-question toast.
Dot clearing rule is an undecided product decision (decision 8, GAP-05), not something the mockup shows. Dot is still drawn on the Devin link while on the page.
Overlay panel covers Pull request, Source and Updated at 1100 and 900; V9 decided to match the real shell. Status and title stay visible.
Real 390px viewport: dialog is 358px wide inside 16px gutters (left 16, right 374); no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth equals 390).
Decision: mobile gets push only; unchanged.
Dialog reads 'Connects Devin for everyone in this space. Read-only.'; 'org-scoped' is gone.
Ask is hidden on Not connected, Loading and Load error. It stays on Empty (agent exists) and Key rejected (see F-STORY-007-03).
'Not connected, a member who may not connect' frame: 'Ask a space owner to connect Devin.', no button.
Stale frame: notice 'Devin rejected the key. Alerts are paused.', tile replaced by the notice, badges and titles muted, dot hidden, row times at least as old as the header.
Question wraps in full (three lines at the docked width), no clamp.
'Answer in Devin' link is gone. The whole row is the target; row heights are 38px or more.
One anchor per row (measured linksPerRow = 1); every cell of a row resolves to that anchor under elementFromPoint.
Toast frame is drawn over Inbox; the Devin page is not behind it.
Top bar is hamburger-only and the 'Devin agent' label is gone (that half resolved), but under 1024px no needs-you signal is visible outside the drawer.
One vocabulary: group and tile 'Needs you', badge 'Needs input' or 'Error', toast title 'Devin needs input'.

new_findings.description: The 'connecting' dialog frame shows Connect disabled with the label 'Connect' and no spinner or 'Connecting' text, so it reads like the empty state with a key typed. At 390px the description breaks at the hyphen ('Read-' / 'only.').
new_findings.expected: A visible in-progress cue; 'Read-only' kept together.
new_findings.actual: Grey Connect button, same label; hyphen wrap at narrow width.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Label the button 'Connecting...' with the real spinner; use a non-breaking hyphen in 'Read-only'.

new_findings.criterion: Controls that cannot work are hidden
new_findings.description: The key-rejected frame still shows Ask. With a rejected key the Devin agent cannot read sessions.
new_findings.expected: Ask hidden while the key is rejected, as on Not connected and Load error.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Hide Ask in the stale frame (V8 rule).

new_findings.description: The key-rejected frame shows Reconnect to everyone. A member who may not replace the shared connection is not given a variant, unlike the not-connected page.
new_findings.expected: A member variant: notice says who can reconnect, no button.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Draw a member variant of the notice without the button (GAP-54).

new_findings.description: Keyboard focus draws a 2px ring around the title only (about 159x18px) while the whole row is the target.
new_findings.expected: Ring around the row (focus-within) so the target and the indicator match.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Outline the row on :focus-within and hide the title outline.

new_findings.description: Panel frame 'the agent cannot read the question' sits next to a table that displays that same question ('Should the export keep the legacy CSV column order?'). If the agent cannot read it, the page cannot either (GAP-01).
new_findings.expected: The row in that frame shows no question, or the agent answers it.
new_findings.actual: Page shows the question; agent says it cannot read it.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Drop the subtitle from the Add CSV export row in that frame, matching the GAP-01 fallback.

new_findings.description: Clicking Ask on 'First visit, panel closed' hides the Ask button (shell gets class open) but no panel appears because that frame has no dock; the first-open state is drawn only as a separate frame.
new_findings.expected: Ask opens the intro panel in the same frame.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Give the first-visit frame the intro dock so the click shows it.

not_observable: Click to real Devin (rows, toast, OS banner, phone push)
